news.headline: Okta, Datadog, Palantir Technologies, Zscaler, and Elastic Shares Are Falling, What You Need To Know
news.summary: A number of stocks fell in the afternoon session after investors shifted their focus from what AI technology can do toward concerns over how companies will finance it.

news.headline: Zscaler (ZS) Draws Pomerantz Probe After Fraud Claims Stir Governance Questions
news.summary: Zscaler (NasdaqGS: ZS) is under investigation by Pomerantz LLP for potential securities fraud and other unlawful business practices. The law firm’s inquiry follows recent financial guidance revisions that coincided with sharp volatility in Zscaler’s share price. Pomerantz is also reviewing circumstances around a recent senior executive departure that has drawn fresh scrutiny from Zscaler investors

news.headline: Cybersecurity Stocks Slide as AI Financing Jitters Spread: Palo Alto Falls 7%, SentinelOne Sinks 9%, Zscaler Drops 6%
news.summary: AI financing jitters are hammering cybersecurity stocks far harder than the broader Nasdaq, leaving investors to wonder whether the sector's demand story can survive the selloff or whether the AI trade just entered its painful second half.

news.headline: Sell-Off In Cybersecurity Stocks Intensifies Amid Palo Alto Vulnerability
news.summary: Cybersecurity stocks sold off again on Friday amid a hacker vulnerability involving a Palo Alto Networks network firewall platform.
